Hi Emily / Devon,

Thanks again for the time today — the discovery call was really helpful. Quick recap and a proposed next step:

Goal: run a 90-minute workshop (architecture alignment + short hands-on inference run) so your engineering and infra teams can validate performance and integration patterns.

Proposed outcomes:
- Confirm model routing and security boundary for PII-sensitive flows
- Validate KV cache behavior with your seq lengths and latency SLOs
- Run a short inference smoke test against a sample workload

Proposed windows (all times shown in PDT / convert as needed):
- Option A: Wed Jun 9, 10:00–11:30 AM PDT
- Option B: Thu Jun 10, 1:00–2:30 PM PDT

Who we'd suggest from Redwood: Jonas Weber (AE, owner), Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) and Laura Bennett (Customer Success) — Ben would lead the hands-on portion.

Can you confirm:
1) Which window works best for the Avery Health team?
2) Final attendee list (we'll add calendar invites once confirmed).
3) Do you prefer Google Meet or Zoom for the session? We can provide a host meeting link.

Prep notes: if you have a small sample dataset and a test service account you want us to smoke test, please share access or a short README ahead of the session.

I'll hold both slots tentatively until I get your reply.

Thanks,
